fix.headline:
Knee yourself

fix.body: Sounds weird, but it works. Try to knee yourself in the face on every rep. [em]Your head and butt come off the ground.[/em] Don't worry, you can't actually break your nose.

cues.title: 3 cues
cues.subtitle: for the toe touch
items: Get your head and butt as far off the ground as you can.
Picture kneeing yourself in the face, every rep.
Slow and controlled. No weight to start.

blocks.title: Send it
blocks.text: to the guy whose toe touches look like he's waving down a cab.

cta.follow: One fix a week, filmed on me.
